content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for UDD Uttarakhand Legal Expert Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.udd.uk.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Urban Development Directorate Uttarakhand (UDD Uttarakhand) for hiring qualified legal professionals on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The position available in this notification is Legal Expert, aimed at providing expert legal guidance and managing department-related legal matters efficiently.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Legal Expert post in the Urban Development Directorate Uttarakhand for the current recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Legal Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an LLB or LLM degree along with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience, including relevant High Court work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary provided for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Legal Expert post will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 75,000/- throughout their contractual employment period.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for UDD Uttarakhand Legal Expert Recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode by sending the filled application form via hand, registered post, or speed post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the completed offline application form along with necessary documents is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Legal Expert position will be made based on an interview conducted by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Director, Urban Development Directorate, 31/62, Rajpur Road adjoining Pine-Hall school, Dehradun, Uttarakhand-248001.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification and application form directly from the official website of the department at www.udd.uk.gov.in.
